record.one_liner: Smartsheet is a work management and project tracking platform with a REST API and an official MCP server.
record.auth_notes: API access tokens are generated in the Smartsheet UI and sent as a Bearer header. OAuth 2.0 is also offered, but it is a 3-legged user-consent flow. Smartsheet Gov and Smartsheet Regions Europe use separate tokens.
record.access_notes: critic: access paid_plan -> self_serve_trial. The getting-started guide says API tokens need a Business, Enterprise, or Advanced Work Management plan, and the legacy Free plan is closed to new signups (only users who had it before 2024-08-28). But new signups get a 30-day free trial (no credit card) that gives access to a Business plan, so a developer can generate a working token inside the trial.
record.api_notes: Fetched docs show a Bearer-token HTTP API with a sheet and column data model. Breadth is a judgement call and was not verified object by object.
record.blocker_notes: critic: verdict blocked -> ready, blocker paid_plan -> none. A 30-day Business-plan trial is self-serve, so there is a credential path without sales; long-term production use needs a paid plan, which is an ordinary subscription not a gate.

evidence.quote: The API authenticates using access tokens (API keys). You can generate access tokens in the Smartsheet UI.
Note that the Smartsheet implementation of OAuth 2.0 is a 3-legged process, which requires human intervention.
Required plan: Business, Enterprise, or Advanced Work Management
Navigate to the API Access tab and select Generate new access token.
The trial gives you access to a Business plan.
You can connect various AI assistants to the Smartsheet Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.
30 days free, no credit card required
